login.description: Sign in to see sensors and alarms.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
changePassword.forcedDescription: This is your first sign-in. Set your own password to continue.

errors.tooShort: The new password must be at least {{count}} characters long
errors.mismatch: The new passwords do not match
errors.sameAsOld: The new password must be different from the current one

form.title: New account
form.description: The login is filled in from the full name. At first sign-in the user sets their own password.

errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {{count}} characters long
errors.rangeRequired: A forester must have a forest range

edit.title: Edit account
edit.activeHint: An inactive account cannot sign in and its session ends at once.
edit.selfHint: You cannot deactivate your own account or change your own role.
edit.resetHint: The backend draws a new temporary password. The current password stops working and the user sets their own at sign-in.

created.title: Account created
created.description: Pass these details on to the user. The password cannot be viewed later.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.added: Sensor {{id}} added. The forester will mount it in the app.

delete.hint: Only a sensor with no alarms or releases.
delete.question: Delete sensor {{id}} for good?
delete.hasHistory: This sensor cannot be deleted, because it has alarms or releases.
delete.switchOffHint: You can switch it off: it stops raising alarms, and the history stays.
delete.alreadyOff: It stays in the system switched off, with its history.

form.title: New sensor
form.description: The sensor will show up on the forester’s list to mount. The phone saves its location when mounting.
form.idHint: 16 characters from the sticker on the sensor. Spaces and dashes are removed.
form.name: Name (optional)
form.nameHint: Usually the forester names it when mounting.

errors.invalidId: The sensor ID must have 16 characters: digits 0–9 and letters A–F

edit.title: Edit sensor
edit.description: After changing the forest range, the sensor is shown to the forester of the new range.
edit.activeHint: A switched-off sensor raises no alarms and its pin is grey. The alarm and release history stays.
edit.activeUnmounted: The sensor switches on by itself when a forester mounts it.

map.title: Sensor map
map.sensorNotFound: Sensor {{id}} is not on the map.

alarms.title: Alarms
alarms.tampering: Possible tampering with the sensor (vibration only, no sound)
alarms.notFound: Alarm {{id}} was not found. It may have been removed or belong to another range.

answer.question: What happened?
answer.theftHint: e.g. the carrier loaded extra logs
answer.falseAlarmHint: e.g. an animal by the pile

mount.title: Mount a sensor
mount.description: Stand by the timber stack and take the location from your phone.
mount.moveDescription: Stand by the new timber stack and take the location from your phone.
mount.name: Name
mount.poorAccuracy: Poor accuracy, try again in the open

errors.unsupported: This browser does not give the location
errors.insecure: Location only works on an https page
errors.denied: No permission for the location. Allow it in the browser settings
errors.unavailable: Could not find the location. Check that GPS is on
errors.timeout: Finding the location took too long. Try again

release.title: Mute for timber pickup
release.description: The sensor raises no alarm while the carrier loads the timber.

releases.title: Timber releases
releases.noOngoing: No sensor is muted right now.
releases.notFound: Release {{id}} is not in the history. It may have been deleted or belong to another range.
releases.noHistoryFiltered: No finished releases in this period.

push.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in the site settings (the lock by the address) and reload the app.
push.unsupported: This device does not support notifications.
push.error: Could not turn on notifications. Try again.
